summary: AI-native engineer and Principal Enterprise AI Architect at Fishbowl Inventory. I design the systems coding agents use to write and verify software, from product discovery and ticket prioritization through test-first implementation, automated QA, and GitLab pipelines. I use run failures and review findings to improve the workflow that produces each change.

roles.title: Principal Enterprise AI Architect
responsibilities: Identified the need for an agent platform and won leadership approval to build it after a structured build, buy, and hybrid evaluation including Glean and RunLayer. As principal engineer, designed Atlas for low swap cost, with employee-created workflows, agents, and skills kept on Fishbowl's own servers.

Built the Atlas Gateway: 177 tools in 25 provider modules over plain MCP, usable from Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, and Cursor. It acts as the employee via OAuth where systems allow, filters tools per user, gates writes for approval, and cut Salesforce connector code 87%.

Built Atlas Studio for non-technical employees on one runtime, identity, and approval model: chat on the Vercel AI SDK in the browser and a Rust-based Tauri desktop shell with a signed auto-updater, versioned skills, and scheduled agents that the database schema requires to name their tools.

Added Apps to Studio: an employee builds a web app, Atlas hosts it as a single-spa micro-frontend, and a consent-gated bridge lets it call the same tools as the person using it, within their permissions and audit trail, with no API keys, backend, or deployment.

In its first eleven days in production (mid August 2026), 65 of Fishbowl's 222 employees used Atlas chat, 85% returned on a different day, and at least 25 worked outside engineering, in support, implementation, sales, and finance.

Designed Atlas Builder so people in support, product, and QA could start a fix from Slack. Led the production rollout for Drive frontend repositories, with isolated Kubernetes execution, test-first plans, independent review, and draft GitLab merge requests.

Instrumented agent runs with failure details, audit events, and model usage by step. Use run results and review findings to refine the context, instructions, tests, and approval gates that guide coding agents.

roles.title: Principal AI Engineer
responsibilities: Built AI coding tools and workflows across Product and Engineering, turning experimentation into repeatable practice.
Architected the Claude Code agentic coding pipeline, MCP context servers, and cloud execution environment.
Designed context engineering systems that turn requirements and institutional knowledge into structured agent inputs.
Built LLM evaluation and automated review loops that check agent output before it reaches a human reviewer.
Drove adoption across Product and Engineering; GitLab commit activity rose broadly, not only among power users.

responsibilities: Led and managed the Fishbowl Inventory cloud application engineering team and drove its technical roadmap.
Mentored engineers through reviews and career planning, and coordinated product, design, and engineering.
Championed an internal context sharing framework that made the team more efficient with agentic AI tools.
Streamlined onboarding from two hours to five minutes.

Unified the UI of multiple products with a Lit-based native web component design system.
Led a 20-member pod as Scrum Master for sprint planning and execution.
Led AI coding tool migrations from Codeium Windsurf to Cursor to Claude Code across engineering.

Directed all frontend work with a team of five engineers, shipping weekly releases.
Built the CI/CD pipeline with Vite, Netlify, and GitHub Actions.
